messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The Ballot Engine Room smells like oil, wet wool, and nervous voters.

The brass counter jerks, clacks, and prints the same name twenty-seven times in a row.

Mira Caldane looks from the paper strip to you.

(Mira Caldane) "That machine is either broken or bought. Help me find out which before they call the election."
